catalogReview.note: Separate chart-specific Catalog review; not a cub check result.

steps: Add resources.limits for memory and CPU to each container
Add resources.requests to enable proper scheduling
Consider LimitRange defaults at the namespace level
commands: kubectl get deployment <name> -n <namespace> -o yaml | grep -A10 resources

next_step.description: Add resources.limits for memory and CPU to each container

findings.name: Deployment containers omit resource requests
findings.message: Deployment containers omit resource requests; HPA and scheduler decisions will be unreliable

steps: Set resources.requests.cpu and resources.requests.memory on every container
Align requests with observed steady-state usage
Ensure requests are set when using HPA

next_step.description: Set resources.requests.cpu and resources.requests.memory on every container

findings.name: Deployment explicitly sets replicas to 1
findings.message: Deployment has replicas: 1; no high availability

steps: Set replicas to at least 2 for services requiring availability
Use HPA with minReplicas >= 2 for auto-scaling workloads
Single replica is acceptable for batch jobs or development

next_step.description: Set replicas to at least 2 for services requiring availability

findings.name: emptyDir volume has no sizeLimit
findings.message: Volume scratch-data uses emptyDir without sizeLimit; may exhaust node disk

steps: Set sizeLimit on all emptyDir volumes
Size the limit based on expected usage with headroom
{'Consider using memory-backed emptyDir (medium': 'Memory) for small caches'}

next_step.description: Set sizeLimit on all emptyDir volumes

findings.name: Deployment does not disable automountServiceAccountToken
findings.message: Deployment does not set automountServiceAccountToken: false; pods get unnecessary API credentials

steps: Set automountServiceAccountToken to false in the pod spec
Only enable it for pods that genuinely need Kubernetes API access
Use dedicated service accounts with minimal RBAC for pods that need API access

next_step.description: Set automountServiceAccountToken to false in the pod spec

findings.name: CCVE-2025-4005
findings.message: Volume webhook-certificates references Secret default/cnpg-webhook-cert which is not present in scanned documents

steps: Verify the ConfigMap or Secret name in the volume reference matches an existing resource
Create the missing ConfigMap/Secret or correct the volume reference

next_step.description: Verify the ConfigMap or Secret name in the volume reference matches an existing resource

findings.name: ClusterRole grants pods/exec create
findings.message: ClusterRole grants pods/exec create, enabling direct command execution in running pods

steps: Remove pods/exec from ClusterRole rules where interactive container access is not strictly required
Restrict role bindings to narrowly scoped operational identities
commands: kubectl get clusterroles -o json | jq '.items[] | select(any(.rules[]?; any(.resources[]?; .=="pods/exec"))) | .metadata.name'

next_step.description: Remove pods/exec from ClusterRole rules where interactive container access is not strictly required
next_step.command: kubectl get clusterroles -o json | jq '.items[] | select(any(.rules[]?; any(.resources[]?; .=="pods/exec"))) | .metadata.name'

findings.name: ClusterRole grants secrets read permissions
findings.message: ClusterRole grants secrets get/list, enabling credential exfiltration across namespaces

steps: Remove secrets get/list permissions from ClusterRoles that do not require credential access
Scope secret access to namespaced Role bindings where possible
commands: kubectl get clusterroles -o json | jq '.items[] | select(any(.rules[]?; any(.resources[]?; .=="secrets"))) | .metadata.name'

next_step.description: Remove secrets get/list permissions from ClusterRoles that do not require credential access
